title: fix: resolve eleven stale exports in local checks
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Local `check:changed` runs report eleven inherited dead exports from #200533, #193550, #198455, and #200817. Those findings obscure regressions in otherwise unrelated branches.

## User Impact

No runtime behavior changes. Plugin authors can name the existing model-request hook and metric contracts through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/plugin-entry`; existing plugin types and callable APIs remain compatible.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep module-only session delivery, cron formatting, and reference-model types private, and inline the obsolete segmented-control test helper at its sole caller. Existing delivery and formatting tests now exercise their production entrypoints. Reuse the existing event-state fixture setup to keep the recovery suite within its line cap.

The six public SDK types remain owned by their existing modules and gain explicit type-only re-exports from the canonical entrypoint. The surface budget increases by exactly six, with the source PRs recorded beside the budget. No Knip ignore or baseline entry is added. Production LOC is +10, entirely those type-only re-exports; no runtime import, config, cache, schema, or dependency is added.

## Evidence

- The six-type plugin consumer fails on the parent with six missing-export errors and compiles with the fix. The committed type contract registers the typed model hook and uses the typed metric producer/exporter APIs.
- Plugin SDK surface and package-export checks pass: 3,888 → 3,894 public exports, zero new callable exports, no unauthorized shipped removals.
- 65 focused core tests pass, covering hook ordering/failure, metrics lifecycle, session-controller custody, recovery delivery, and Gateway cron suppression. The three cases using the consolidated fixture setup are rechecked on the final patch.
- 186 cron unit/browser tests and all four production-build Chromium schedule-editing E2E scenarios pass. UI test time: 9.97s plus 0.806s browser layout; E2E: 29.73s, build: 13.07s. Core wrapper: 297.42s, including worker preparation and Gateway integration setup.
- Root contract/tooling typechecks and the line-cap guard pass. The new import contract adds no runtime test process.

The untouched main parent `34d6c288fe1c46a369ff4171a103226b8c6059e3` also has four newer findings: `gbrainReleaseAsset` and `attestsGbrainRelease` from #200987 (`0ff7e2772eb15`), and `buildMessageToolSchema` and `resolveMessageToolActionSchemaActions` from #197553 (`34d6c288fe1c4`). Parent-relative source diffs identify their introduction/last-consumer removal. The original eleven findings are absent after this patch; those four remain a separately attributed main regression. Aggregate scan counts are 12 → 4 production, 9 → 1 full-tree, and 0 → 0 script entries. This does not claim a clean aggregate scan.

Codex autoreview P0–P2 on the final local patch against parent `34d6c288fe1c46a369ff4171a103226b8c6059e3`: scoped-clean, no accepted/actionable findings. The three consolidated recovery cases pass in 24.26s Vitest / 31.63s wrapper. `pnpm check:changed` completed with every check passing except the four attributed inherited dead exports listed above. This includes core/UI/extension/script/test typechecks, SDK boundary declaration emission, scoped lint, dependency and database guards, and format checks. No check was skipped or weakened.
